name: Fou
source:
No. 6 of the temple knights. He admires [url=/c52403]Ray[/url] like an older brother.
He has a lot of pride in his abilities but that's why he's always clashing with [url=/c54820]Gargado[/url]
His body was also augmented like Ray, but because the technology was better he only lost some of his sense of taste.
